about:
Brandywine Electronics Ltd, operating as BEL.com, is a full-service audio-visual company headquartered in Bear, Delaware. Founded in 1974, the business has served the Mid-Atlantic region for over four decades. The company's ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

BEL.com operates through three primary divisions: design and installation of permanent AV systems, event production and equipment rentals, and service and repair for professional audio and video gear. The firm maintains a rental inventory that includes wireless microphone systems, video projectors, pop-up theatre projection screens, and self-powered speakers and subwoofers. It holds factory-authorized warranty status for brands such as Harman Professional Products and is a designated QSC Premier service center, enabling in-house warranty repairs for those product lines.

The company serves houses of worship, educational institutions, commercial clients, and the entertainment sector. Past projects include the auditorium overhaul at Cab Calloway School of the Arts, AV installations for the City of Milford Council Chambers and Delaware School for the Deaf, and production support for the FIRST Lego League event. Corporate clients such as Computer Sciences Corporation and Wharton Computing and IT have cited multi-year service agreements, while performers including Emo Phillips, Roy Clark, and Shelly West have acknowledged live-sound support.

BEL.com emphasizes responsive service, noting that no project or event is considered too large or too small. Testimonials highlight emergency service calls that saved critical meetings and a streamlined ticketing system for both ship-in and walk-in repairs.
